name: GAIB sAID
oneLiner: sAID is GAIB's staked AI Dollar vault: AID is deposited into an ERC-4626 vault tracking AI infrastructure financing NAV with a 30-day FIFO unstaking cycle.
collateral: AID staked into GAIB's ERC-4626 sAID vault; vault capital is deployed into AI infrastructure financings (GPUs, robotics, and related compute) plus a stable reserve buffer of T-bills and stablecoins for liquidity
pegMechanism: sAID is minted by staking AID at the staking NAV (which ignores unrealized losses, keeping the mint price stable) rather than pegged to $1. Redemptions follow a monthly withdrawal-cohort cycle: requests submitted within a calendar month are aggregated, liquidity is sourced the following month, and funds settle on the first day of the third month at the unstaking NAV (which subtracts unrealized losses). Selling sAID on a supported DEX is the immediate-liquidity alternative.

slice.name: AID vault shares and AI infrastructure financing portfolio

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sAID is the AI-infrastructure financing vault layer and intentionally departs from the liquid AID parent reserve archetype.
